coursework.summary: No university-wide AI coursework permission, prohibition or mandate was established. Institutional tool access and comparative policy classifications cannot supply that missing assessment rule.

exams.summary: Undergraduate examinations restrict devices unless the chief examiner provides otherwise and require independent answers. These are general exam rules, not a verified uniform AI examination policy for every student.

ai_disclosure.summary: Declarations are required in the specified School of Integrated Circuits doctoral proposal and comprehensive-examination documents. No universal PKU AI declaration requirement is established; pre-defense wording and the revision chain retain explicit gaps.

privacy_data_entry.summary: Administrative-data systems have scoped security obligations; China Economic Quarterly referees must not upload confidential review material to public AI. These do not impose a uniform student AI registration procedure.

academic_integrity.summary: General independent-work, attribution and misconduct procedures are distinguished from explicit School of Integrated Circuits AI restrictions. Findings and appropriate procedures are required; no automatic AI or detector-score penalty is established.

teaching_guidance.summary: A teaching-centre report describes preliminary AI marking followed by teacher/TA review. This is a service workflow and reported practice, not a verified university-wide authorisation for autonomous final AI grading.

research_guidance.summary: Explicit restrictions apply to named School of Integrated Circuits doctoral procedures and China Economic Quarterly referees. The Department of Information Management comparative resource is not treated as binding university-wide policy.

security_procurement.summary: Administrative-data safeguards have a specific institutional management scope. Final enactment of the model-security document titled 拟公开 remains unverified; no blanket student approval procedure is inferred.

approved_tools.summary: The official directory lists 33 distinct services/resources. Access for Wenxue, Xiaobei and the teacher-facing Doujiao announcement has specific conditions; other directory entries do not establish universal accounts or assessment permission.

named_ai_services.summary: Named institutional platforms exist, with documented audience and role conditions for selected services. Directory membership is not recommendation, student entitlement or coursework/exam authorisation.

policy_presence.summary: Official unit-specific AI rules and general academic regulations are available, alongside comparative resources and a document of unresolved final status. A comprehensive university-wide AI assessment policy was not established.
